name: Rule V
placementTarget: Rulebook Game End, step 1 Adjust Population, as step a. The manual's last page says Rule Sticker V gives step a and to skip it until this sticker is placed.
summary: Step a. Do not decrease the population of cities that contain a shelter. Skip steps b and c below for those cities. No P3 code is printed on the sticker. The rule letter V is the manual's name for this slot.

mechanics.timing: Game end, step 1 Adjust Population, step a. It is in force once the sticker is in the rulebook.
mechanics.effect: A city that contains a shelter does not lose population in this step. Skip step b (the plague-cube decrease) and step c for that city. Step c is the slot the manual reserves for Rule Sticker W.
restrictions: Only cities that contain a shelter.
The sticker names steps b and c. It does not say to skip step d, the supply-center increase.
No door and no production cost.
